exposure: Prior review of Kato1999 primitive input and retained Kato definition imports; read current main and accepted local-cone review before this targeted comparison. No claim of new independent source-first reconstruction.
observations: Kato1999 §0.1 p314 defines etale cohomology on O_K[1/N] by finite coefficient inverse limits. §0.5 p316 takes norm inverse limits and defines subscript-zero by all local H2 restrictions at primes dividing N. There is no G_S cochain definition to substitute.

Kato2004 §8.2 pp180–181 defines Hq(R,M) using ordinary j_* of the generic-point sheaf, then finite coefficient inverse limits. The Iwasawa definition is §12.2 p220, not §12.1 (which describes the algebra).

The finite-coefficient adjunction map i_*M→Ri_*M on X=Spec O_K[1/2], i:U=X minus odd support→X, has cone supported at those odd points. Derived stalk theorem identifies its stalks with positive inertia cohomology.
The source-local cone is accepted separately. Its degree-one vanishing after rational sign localization is needed; a finite H1 injection alone cannot establish the H2 kernel comparison.
